title: Why Teen Vaping Crashed, Then Nicotine Came Back
hook: The vaping crisis didn't end. It just moved.
closing: One nicotine habit down, a stealthier one clocked in.
question: Know anyone who vapes or uses pouches?

segments.say: By 2019, 27.5 percent of high schoolers vaped -- more than one in four teenagers using e-cigarettes regularly.
After flavor bans and FDA crackdowns, vaping crashed to just 7.8 percent by 2024, the lowest in a decade.
E-cigarettes are still the top seller, now trailed by nicotine pouches at just 1.8 percent.
